prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return Solution.java defining public final class Solution.
Required API: public static String canonicalPath(String base, List<String> segments)
Behavior: Join a base absolute slash path and relative path segments. Ignore empty and dot segments, resolve dot-dot without escaping root, collapse repeated slashes, and return null/None/error marker for a non-absolute base or an attempted root escape. The root result is '/'.
Visible example: base /a/b with segments ../c, ./d becomes /a/c/d; base / with .. is rejected.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: import java.util.*;public final class Solution{public static String canonicalPath(String b,List<String>s){if(!b.startsWith("/"))return null;var p=new ArrayList<String>();var all=new ArrayList<String>();all.add(b);all.addAll(s);for(var r:all)for(var x:r.split("/")){if(x.isEmpty()||x.equals("."))continue;if(x.equals("..")){if(p.isEmpty())return null;p.remove(p.size()-1);}else p.add(x);}return "/"+String.join("/",p);}}
